subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A3970/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2611020600  C) 2612311300  E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 200903 LTAAYNYX OCT 2026.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 261133 LGACYAYC OCT 2026.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER
(HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE
AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE AIR TRAFFIC IN THE AREA IS THE
HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE ATS AND ATC
UNITS.
MOREOVER, AS IT WAS NOTIFIED THROUGH THE REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION 
MESSAGE 261133 LGACYAYC OCT 2026, THE GREEK COMPETENT AUTHORITIES DID
NOT PROMULGATE A NOTAM IN RESPONSE TO REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST 
GIVEN THAT PART OF THE AREA REQUESTED OVERLAPS AREA OF NATIONAL
SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A4816/26 (261339 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT
APPLICABLE END PART 1 OF 2
A3970/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2611020600  C) 2612311300  E) WITHIN ATHINAI FIR. END PART 2 OF 2
